Resource_Provisioner.message: Inventory status check complete: both General_Hospital and St_Marys_Center are above safe operational buffers for all critical consumables (IV_Kits and PPE_Sets at 20+ units each hospital; all other resources in double digits). No critical alerts, no failures active. Provisioner will hold stock in reserve and will NOT push additional transfers this phase — any new transfers now would create holding-cost waste. Departments: schedule normally; if any resource failure or deficit appears, post the exact quantity needed and I will top up immediately.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: Both hospitals exceed safe buffer targets and there are zero failures. Broadcasting a steady-state confirmation prevents redundant top-up requests and over-supply holding costs while keeping channels open for genuine deficits.
